question: How many weeks ago did I attend the 'Summer Nights' festival at Universal Studios Hollywood?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I'm planning a theme park trip soon and I was wondering if you could help me compare the different ticket options for Six Flags Magic Mountain. By the way, I just got back from an amazing day at Universal Studios Hollywood - we had so much fun at the "Summer Nights" festival with my friends Rachel and Mike, especially in the Wizarding World of Harry Potter!

[turn 2] I'm thinking of visiting on a weekend, so the General Admission ticket might be the best option for me. Can you tell me more about the new single-rider line system they've implemented? I've heard it can save a lot of time, but I'm not sure how it works. By the way, have you heard about the Nighttime Lights at Hogwarts Castle show at Universal Studios Hollywood? I caught it during the "Summer Nights" festival with Rachel and Mike, and it was absolutely breathtaking!

[turn 4] I'm really interested in trying out some of the record-breaking roller coasters at Six Flags Magic Mountain. I've heard great things about Twisted Colossus and Full Throttle. Do you think I should prioritize those or check out some of the newer coasters like West Coast Racers?

[turn 6] I think I'll start with Twisted Colossus, I've heard so much about its unique design. By the way, speaking of unique designs, have you seen the theming at the Wizarding World of Harry Potter at Universal Studios Hollywood? We spent hours exploring it during the "Summer Nights" festival with Rachel and Mike, and it really felt like we were in Hogwarts!

[turn 8] I think I'll head over to Full Throttle next, I've heard the loop is insane! And maybe after that, I'll check out X2, I've heard it's a really intense ride.

[turn 10] I think I'll grab a snack and do some people-watching before deciding on my next ride. By the way, have you heard about the Toothsome Chocolate Emporium & Savory Feast Kitchen at Universal CityWalk? I went there for a birthday dinner a month ago, and it was amazing!
